text:
Emma (Support): Hey team — AcmeOps (Leo) opened a ticket: streaming responses cut off mid-event after ~30s when requests route through our ALB + Cloudflare combo. Client reconnects and gets a 302 from the edge, then the library replays the last chunk and app duplicates tokens.

Leo (Customer): Repro locally: works fine. Only happens when we put traffic behind our ALB + Cloudflare worker. We see partial message, then connection closes. Reconnect returns 302 and SSE client library tries to resume.

Raj (SRE): Can you paste a minimal repro curl request and the response headers you see? Also which protocol? h1 or h2 between CF and ALB?

Leo (Customer): Using fetch in browser + our worker. Headers captured from the browser: 
```
:status: 200
content-type: text/event-stream
cache-control: no-cache
connection: keep-alive
x-edge-rewrite: /v1/stream
set-cookie: session=abc; Path=/; HttpOnly
```
On reconnect attempt we get: 
```
:status: 302
location: /auth/refresh
```

Emma (Support): That 302 is odd — looks like an auth cookie expiry race on our origin or the worker is rewriting unauthenticated requests to /auth/refresh. Could be the ALB health probe or sticky-session TTL interfering.

Marta (Eng-Infra): @Raj can you check whether ALB is returning any 302 on idle connection revalidation? Also check CF worker edge cache behavior for long-lived SSE. CF sometimes rewrites on cookie mismatch.

Raj (SRE): Looking at logs for the request id Leo sent (he provided X-Request-Id): I see an origin response 200, then 32s later a follow-up request from the worker with cookie-only headers and a 302 from our origin auth service. Tracing suggests the worker reissued a new request when the ALB connection was silently half-closed.

Emma (Support): Steps to reproduce proposed:
1) Put a simple SSE endpoint on a test host behind ALB.
2) Put a CF worker in front that forwards cookies.
3) Idle connection for ~30s.
4) Trigger network jitter / half-close.
Expected: client keeps SSE stream alive or reconnects cleanly. Observed: CF replays/reissues request -> origin returns 302 -> client library double-plays last event.

Marta (Eng-Infra): Quick mitigation options: disable Cloudflare HTTP/2 prioritization for the route, disable CF worker rewrite for auth on SSE path, and set ALB idle timeout > 60s. Also set cache-control: no-transform to prevent worker from transforming responses.

Raj (SRE): Confirmed that increasing ALB idle timeout to 120s prevented the worker reissue in our lab. Also turning on proxy_buffering off at nginx (if present) helped for some cases.

Emma (Support): Can we get a short checklist for Support to send customers?

Marta (Eng-Infra): Checklist: 
- Ensure origin SSE endpoint sends periodic comment keepalive (e.g., `: keepalive\n\n`).
- Set ALB idle timeout >= expected SSE idle period (recommend 120s).
- In Cloudflare worker, avoid rewriting to auth redirects for event-stream endpoints; return 401 JSON instead for API.
- Add `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `Connection: keep-alive` on origin.
- If using nginx/proxies, ensure `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout` high enough.

DeployBot: Canary route update deployed to staging with ALB timeout 120s and worker bypass for /v1/stream.

Emma (Support): Thanks — Leo, can you test with those changes and report back? If it persists, we'll collect a pcap and full header traces. :thumbsup:

Leo (Customer): Will try today and report. Appreciate the quick help!
